ai.prediction_writeup: Manchester City's perfect start to the season and five-match winning streak are impossible to ignore, especially against a Liverpool side that has drawn three of five despite decent underlying performances. While Anfield has historically been a fortress against City, the visitors have won two straight in this fixture and appear to have found answers to Liverpool's pressing system. The belt stays with the team in form—City's momentum and clinical finishing in recent weeks should be enough to edge a tight contest and extend their reign to five defenses.
